name: api-scenarios-remote-finalize
description: The api-scenarios-canonical simulator (the same api_scenarios definition and serial, fixed_part_length upload profile; see that preset) for a site whose uploads go to a remote server mount or a Files.com Agent: a finalize that sends async_finalize true is completed in the background, as the files-rails background finalization of draft MR 8639 answers one. Each upload's first three finalize requests are answered 202 {"status": "pending", "ref"} without progress, then with progress 42, then with progress 100 (pending at 100 is not complete); the next one completes it and that and every later one get the retained File. Its check, files.finalize_upload background, follows each finalized upload in the journal: answered pending at least once, then completed, every request with the same identity headers. A client that does not send async_finalize, or stops waiting while the upload is pending, fails the check. The pending answers and their progress are simulation policy, not what any remote server or Agent reports.
